scan_text: Lifelong learning has become increasingly important in contemporary society. With the rapid development of technology, the knowledge we acquire at school is no longer sufficient for a rapidly changing world. Therefore, individuals should take effective measures to update their skills and broaden their horizons. Moreover, lifelong learning is conducive to both personal growth and social progress. It is high time that we attached greater importance to continuous education. In conclusion, those who keep learning are more likely to seize opportunities and cope with challenges.
essay:
Lifelong learning is very important in modern society. With the development of society, knowledge changes quickly, so people need to learn all the time. If we stop learning, we will fall behind. Many people think that learning is only for students, but this idea is wrong. Adults also need to learn new skills to get better jobs.

There are many good sides of lifelong learning. First, it can help people solve problems. Second, it makes our life more beautiful and helps us make more friends. Third, it can improve our ability and make us more confident. For example, an old worker can learn to use computers and find a new job.

In a word, lifelong learning is good for both people and society. We should pay attention to it and spend more time on reading and studying. Only in this way can we have a better future.
essay_prompt: Directions: Write an essay on the importance of lifelong learning. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
translation_zh: 中国的高铁发展迅速，已成为人们出行的重要方式。高铁不仅缩短了城市之间的距离，也促进了经济和文化交流。越来越多的外国人选择乘坐高铁游览中国。高铁是中国现代化建设的一张名片。
translation_ref: China's high-speed railway has developed rapidly and has become an important way for people to travel. It not only shortens the distance between cities but also promotes economic and cultural exchanges. An increasing number of foreigners choose to travel around China by high-speed rail. High-speed rail is a calling card of China's modernization.

High-speed railway is a card of China's modern construction.
